summary: GreenPower Motor filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the effective date for a one-for-five reverse share consolidation. Nasdaq approved the Consolidation; it becomes effective October 19, 2026. Outstanding shares fall from 10,503,546 to 2,100,710, with fractional shares rounded up and no cash paid for fractions. Options, warrants and convertible debentures will be proportionally adjusted. Computershare will mail letters of transmittal. Symbol remains GP. This is a routine listing-maintenance capital-structure action, not a special situation; monitor continued Nasdaq bid-price and equity-compliance risk.
